title: Chapter 05 — Elasticity
desc: Price elasticity of demand by the midpoint method, the total revenue test, how elasticity varies along a linear curve, and income and cross-price elasticity.
intro: Chapter 4 told you the direction. Elasticity puts a number on the size, and that number decides whether a price rise makes you richer or poorer — which is why this chapter owns the revenue test and, later, who really pays a tax.
